# PyPI maintenance status

> Is a Python package still maintained? Weekly maintenance signals for the 1000 most-downloaded PyPI packages. Updated 2026-11-19 03:52 UTC.

- [All packages, JSON](https://jasontkg.github.io/pypi-maintenance-status/api/all.json)
- [Method](https://jasontkg.github.io/pypi-maintenance-status/method/)
- Per package: https://jasontkg.github.io/pypi-maintenance-status/<package>/ (HTML) and https://jasontkg.github.io/pypi-maintenance-status/api/<package>.json
- Any package in 7 ecosystems, live: https://package-maintenance.mnpi.workers.dev/v1/{ecosystem}/{name} (JSON) and MCP server https://package-maintenance.mnpi.workers.dev/mcp
